continuity_scope: DRAGON QUEST III HD-2D Remake, North American English launch edition (14 November 2024), treated as one numbered-title continuity within the Dragon Quest anthology. It is not a shared-continuity claim for other numbered Dragon Quest titles, spinoffs, or crossover games.
work_or_witnesses: Square Enix official DRAGON QUEST III HD-2D Remake product page (North American English)
Square Enix official release announcement: DRAGON QUEST III HD-2D Remake is releasing on 14th November 2024!
coverage_rule: All individually named, non-avatar characters explicitly named in the selected official launch-story synopsis: Ortega and Baramos. The selected official character section labels the protagonist as '(you)' and makes their gender/player presentation selectable, so that silent player avatar is retained only as a role/source term and is not a character record.
omissions: The unnamed player-controlled protagonist/Hero of Aliahan, who the official page calls 'you' and presents as a selectable protagonist rather than a stable personal name.
The unnamed king of Aliahan, Ortega's unnamed wife, unnamed party allies, and all unnamed monsters/inhabitants.
Every character from Dragon Quest I, II, IV and later numbered titles; Dragon Quest Builders, Monsters, Heroes, Tact, The Adventure of Dai, and all crossovers.
Original 1988 versions, prior remakes/remasters, regional editions, and post-launch update-specific mechanics.
uncertainties: The official product synopsis is deliberately high level and names only two non-avatar individuals. This pass is complete only under that explicit-name witness rule, not a complete cast reconstruction.

Names and wording follow the North American English official localization. Japanese names, other regional localization spellings, and older English localization variants are not merged without an edition-specific official witness.

This is a modern remake with stated new features, additional narrative, and secrets. No character or system claim from another version is treated as launch-remake evidence unless the selected official page says it.
The release announcement spoils Ortega's failure and the premise; no later plot outcome is included.
evidence_basis: First-party Square Enix product-page story and character sections for all character, relationship, avatar, setting, and terminology claims; first-party Square Enix release announcement for the exact edition/date and remake boundary. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, or unofficial database was used.

supports: Ortega, Baramos, their stated conflict, Aliahan, avatar status, and party/allies wording
